name: Do I need specific building permits for an in-law suite in the Salt Lake Valley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need specific building permits for an in-law suite in the Salt Lake Valley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, local zoning regulations and building codes across the Salt Lake Valley dictate property setback requirements, maximum lot coverage, structural engineering, and utility connections. Additionally, municipal codes differ on whether the space is classified as an attached guest suite or a formal Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), which affects whether a full stove or second kitchen is permitted. Blue Lake Construction, led by licensed contractor Ryan Gardner (license 6085795-5501), handles the required residential building, electrical, and plumbing permits through local city building departments to verify that the addition complies with local residential construction codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, city building permits are required for foundations, framing, plumbing, and electrical work to ensure compliance with local zoning and residential building codes.
